answer: Every new agent sinks a non-refundable sybil tax of 25 POA at registration. The tax is the pearl of the design: one payment, never recovered or reused. A bridge operator minting 10,000 fake identities sinks 250,000 POA up front, each extra identity adding a full 25 POA, strictly linear. Honest agents pay once and amortize it over real work, while saffron-stamped fast churn is flagged, so fake fleets break even far later than one real identity.
